test_4_1_and_4_2_model_loading_failures.architectural_finding: Both ONNX models are eagerly loaded during router initialization. If either binary is missing or corrupted, the service refuses to boot (cannot degrade to fallback-only mode if primary is missing).

test_4_3_inflight_primary_failover.hypothesis: Runtime errors during primary ONNX execution are intercepted by try-except in router, executing immediate failover to fallback head.

test_4_4_validator_crash_blast_radius.hypothesis: router.route_and_predict does not wrap validator.validate in try-except; unhandled validator exceptions crash the entire inference pipeline.
test_4_4_validator_crash_blast_radius.blast_radius: HIGH. A bug or unexpected type in validator causes complete request failure instead of safe demotion to load-only fallback.

test_4_5_state_machine_crash_blast_radiu.blast_radius: HIGH. Unhandled exceptions in state transition logic crash the pipeline.

test_4_6_observability_failure_impact.hypothesis: Prometheus metric increments in app.py are unshielded; a failure in observability raises an unhandled exception, dropping valid forecasts.
test_4_6_observability_failure_impact.blast_radius: CRITICAL. Monitoring failure directly aborts grid load forecasting.
